LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.PhaseV.Title: Phase V: The Vault
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.PhaseV.Body: Site geometry suggests a sealed inner chamber — the vault. Our scan resolves several anomalies; one of them should be the access point.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.V.Ferengi.Title: Ferengi broker hails
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.V.Ferengi.Body: A Ferengi broker (likely on private subspace) offers “exclusive coordinates”: a precise map of the inner ring. Klingon sources call his claim “laughable”; the Romulans say nothing — which is rarely a good sign. The broker insists on an “immediate transaction”.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.V.Ferengi.Deal.Label: Accept the deal (off-record)
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.V.Ferengi.Refuse.Label: Refuse (maintain protocol)
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.V.Ferengi.Deal.ConfirmText: The broker transmits encrypted raster data. Attached note: “noise-sensitive lock” — likely an acoustic or subsonic mechanism. We can integrate the data into our map.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.V.Ferengi.Refuse.Title: Offer declined
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.V.Ferengi.Refuse.Text: We refuse and cite Starfleet protocol. The broker “regrets” our decision and records “future terms”. Expect Ferengi scrutiny on any subsequent transmission.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.V.Vault.NextText: Anomalies are now marked. With the (lawfully acquired or “supplemented”) data, we should locate the access point. Prepare a team for the breach.
